question: In each pyrolysis run, what N2 flow rate, sample mass and holding time in the hot zone were used?
trap: the 20 °C/min heating rate or the 300 s purge
rendered:
The N2 flow rate was maintained at 3 L min−1 by a mass flow controller. 
The sample mass was 0.5 g (±0.005 g). 
The holding time in the hot zone was 20 min.
